newsitem.title: USA: Hoenig names Sapirstein chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Hoenig names Sapirstein chairman, CEO.

text.p: Heonig Group Inc said Thursday Fredric Sapirstein has been elected by the board as chairman, chief executive and a director of the company, effective immediately.

Sapirstein replaces Joseph D'Andrea, who was serving as interim chairman after the death of chairman and founder, Ronald Hoenig. D'Andrea will remain as a director and vice president in charge of business development, the company said.
Sapirstein, 54, joins Hoenig from Bear Stearns, where he was most recently head of Asian Investment Banking, based in Hong Kong.
